milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the chiseled stone bricks and face toward them, modeling 'player can see the target.' Target is set to (10, 2, 13) — the center of the largest cluster of chiseled stone bricks (back wall, 4 blocks). max_distance=10 allows detection from outside the structure (confirmed visible at ~5 blocks in sandbox step 014). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the blocks.
